issues.title: [LMVLLM] Implement chat session forking with context preservation
issues.description: When forking a chat, preserve full context including system prompt, tool calls, and assistant responses. Branch visualization in UI. Merge branches back if needed.

issues.title: [LMVLLM] Create model download and HuggingFace integration
issues.description: Add UI to browse/search HuggingFace models, download directly to models directory. Progress tracking, resume interrupted downloads, checksum verification.

issues.title: [LMVLLM] Add real-time GPU metrics streaming via WebSocket
issues.description: Stream GPU utilization, memory, temperature, power draw via WebSocket to frontend. Historical charts, alerts on thermal throttling, memory leaks detection.

issues.title: [LMVLLM] Build recipe versioning and rollback system
issues.description: Version recipes on changes, maintain history. One-click rollback to previous recipe versions. Diff view between versions. Auto-backup before destructive changes.

issues.title: [LMVLLM] Implement graceful model switching with request draining
issues.description: When switching models, drain in-flight requests gracefully with timeout. Queue new requests during switch, replay after new model ready. Zero-downtime model swaps.

issues.title: [LMVLLM] Create model warm-up and benchmark automation
issues.description: Auto-run warm-up prompts after model load, benchmark tokens/sec, measure time-to-first-token. Store benchmarks per recipe for comparison. Alert on performance degradation.

issues.title: [LMVLLM] Add multi-GPU load balancing and tensor parallel auto-detection
issues.description: Auto-detect available GPUs and suggest optimal tensor_parallel_size. Implement round-robin and least-loaded balancing for multi-model scenarios. GPU affinity pinning.

issues.title: [LMVLLM] Build recipe validation and compatibility checker
issues.description: Validate recipes before launch: check GPU memory requirements vs available VRAM, verify model path exists, validate quantization compatibility. Fail fast with clear error messages.

issues.title: [LMVLLM] Implement automatic model eviction with LRU caching
issues.description: Add memory-aware LRU cache for loaded models. Auto-evict least recently used models when GPU memory pressure detected. Configurable memory thresholds and eviction policies.

issues.title: [Clawdis] Implement AI response caching and deduplication
issues.description: Cache common AI responses, detect duplicate/similar questions, serve cached responses with freshness indicators. Reduce AI API costs and latency.

issues.title: [Clawdis] Add end-to-end message delivery confirmation
issues.description: Track message delivery status through entire pipeline: sent -> gateway -> platform -> delivered -> read. Surface in logs and optionally notify sender.

issues.title: [Clawdis] Create bridge mode for cross-platform messaging
issues.description: Bridge messages between WhatsApp and Telegram: forward messages between linked chats, maintain formatting, handle media transcoding between platforms.

issues.title: [Clawdis] Build conversation export and backup system
issues.description: Add conversation export: JSON, Markdown, PDF formats. Include media attachments, searchable archive. Scheduled automatic backups to configurable location.

issues.title: [Clawdis] Implement voice wake word customization UI
issues.description: Enhance mac app voice settings: add custom wake word training, sensitivity adjustment per word, visual feedback during recognition, error sound on failed recognition.

issues.title: [Clawdis] Add multi-account WhatsApp support
issues.description: Support multiple WhatsApp accounts with routing rules. Different accounts for different use cases. Account health monitoring and automatic failover.

issues.title: [Clawdis] Create scheduled message and reminder system
issues.description: Add ability to schedule messages: clawdis schedule --to X --at '2pm' --message 'reminder'. Store in SQLite, background worker for delivery. Support recurring.

issues.title: [Clawdis] Implement Telegram inline mode and rich formatting
issues.description: Add Telegram inline bot mode, support Markdown/HTML formatting in responses, inline keyboards for actions, and callback query handling.

issues.title: [Clawdis] Build WhatsApp reaction and reply threading support
issues.description: Support WhatsApp reactions (emoji responses), proper reply threading with quoted messages, and read receipts. Maintain thread context in AI responses.

issues.title: [Clawdis] Add rate limiting and abuse prevention
issues.description: Implement per-sender rate limits, spam detection, blocklist management. Add cooldown periods and graceful degradation under load. Log abuse attempts.

issues.title: [Clawdis] Create health monitoring dashboard endpoint
issues.description: Add /health dashboard with WebSocket connection status, message throughput, error rates, queue depth, session counts. Expose Prometheus metrics for grafana.

issues.title: [Clawdis] Implement conversation memory and context windows
issues.description: Add per-sender conversation history with configurable context window. Summarize old context, persist across gateway restarts. Add memory search/recall commands.

issues.title: [Clawdis] Build unified media transcoding pipeline
issues.description: Consolidate media handling: auto-convert formats for each platform, compress images intelligently, handle voice note transcription failures gracefully with retry.

issues.title: [Clawdis] Add group chat smart filtering and context awareness
issues.description: Improve group chat handling: track conversation threads, implement smarter mention detection, add context from recent messages before responding. Reduce noise in busy groups.

issues.title: [Clawdis] Implement multi-platform message queue with persistence
issues.description: Add SQLite-backed message queue for offline message handling. Queue messages when WhatsApp/Telegram disconnected, replay on reconnect. Add queue inspection CLI commands.

issues.title: [Orchestra] Create hub-and-spoke coordination stress tests
issues.description: Test orchestrator coordination with 5+ concurrent workers, task delegation, result aggregation, and failure handling when workers crash.

issues.title: [Orchestra] Build SDK workspace component tests
issues.description: Test the SDK workspace UI: session management, worker spawning from UI, real-time log streaming, and SQLite preference persistence.

issues.title: [Orchestra] Add vision worker auto-routing tests
issues.description: Test image analysis routing, screenshot interpretation, UI mockup review. Verify vision job logging to jobs.jsonl and result caching.

issues.title: [Orchestra] Implement worker specialization benchmarks
issues.description: Create benchmark suite comparing specialized workers vs general workers on specific task types. Measure accuracy, speed, and token efficiency per worker type.

issues.title: [Orchestra] Create Linear integration automation for task lifecycle
issues.description: Build bidirectional sync: auto-create issues from TODOs, update status from worker progress, and close issues on completion. Add label management and priority inference.

issues.title: [Orchestra] Add Neo4j memory system integration tests
issues.description: Test memory persistence, retrieval, and context injection with Neo4j backend. Verify memory pruning, relevance scoring, and cross-session memory sharing.

issues.title: [Orchestra] Implement async job correctness verification
issues.description: Enhance async job tests to verify actual output quality, not just completion. Add timeout handling, retry logic testing, and job state persistence validation.

issues.title: [Orchestra] Build massive task testing framework with parallel execution
issues.description: Create stress tests with complex multi-file refactoring tasks, large codebase analysis, and parallel worker coordination. Measure reliability and throughput under load.

issues.title: [Orchestra] Add comprehensive permission testing for all tool restrictions
issues.description: Expand from 1 test to full coverage: filesystem read/write, bash restrictions, network permissions, tool whitelisting/blacklisting. Test permission inheritance and override scenarios.

issues.title: [Orchestra] Implement quality evaluation test suite for worker responses
issues.description: Add tests that verify worker output correctness beyond simple contains OK checks. Include coding quality evals, architecture review quality, and documentation accuracy scoring. Reference E2E_BENCHMARK_GAPS.md gaps.
